1.0.0.en:
The adapter was refactored to TypeScript and JsonConfig
Breaking change: Node.js >= 22 is required now
`request` / `request-promise` were replaced by `axios`
Fixed crashes (unreachable host, no enabled monitor), multiplying login timers and websocket connections, polling that stopped after one error
Adapter requires admin >= 7.7.22 now
Adapter requires js-controller >= 6.0.11 now
Dependencies have been updated
